headers.subject: Update on your application to Northwind Robotics

snippet: Dear Mateo, thank you for interviewing with Northwind Robotics. We have decided to continue with other candidates for the Robotics Software Engineer role.
bodyHtml:
Dear Mateo,

Thank you for interviewing with Northwind Robotics. We have decided to continue with other candidates for the Robotics Software Engineer role (R-10442).

We appreciate your time and wish you success.

Northwind Robotics Talent Acquisition

extraction.summary: Northwind Robotics chose to continue with other candidates.
